changed: The invariants of eight fleet records. fleet-host-loss-takes-each-lost-shard-over-on-its-named-standby-with-one-owner-per-tenure: a standby's period reads its witness on its own host's clock when the host loop takes it from the inbox, a witness held past its expiry starts no takeover, issues no device command and writes no shard record, the CAS-BEFORE-DEVICE assertion also needs the period's own last shard-record write to have an acknowledged Committed reply, a lost host that returns as owner after uncommitted takeovers restarts over return slots of its own, the untouched-shard check counts the hosts' record views apart, the two-loads witness counts takeover loads started by one member, a recovery's rounds end when its own session becomes active, and a bring-up phase is judged against the fleet's wait by the round it ended in. fleet-host-loss-keeps-each-hosts-recovery-reads-within-its-share: H3's two takeover loads of the limited shape overlap, each owner's limiter drains its own part of the host's share, and plant IgnoredShare (code 95) is a second control of the limiter check. fleet-serving-duties-retry-an-unknown-store-result-in-place-and-withdraw-on-a-regressed-read: the regression scenarios require the same host's rerun after the teardown (REGRESSION_RERAN), a torn row whose owner kept its custody fails TORN_KEPT and a rerun with no free slot fails UNSLOTTED. fleet-zone-loss-retains-every-volume-and-each-returning-owner-fences-before-its-first-admission: a tenure acquired under a pre-read record naming another owner is dropped unserved and fails DEPOSED_SERVED (plant ForeignPreRead, code 96), and the returning owners' restarts load in the same rounds. fleet-host-driver-keeps-no-epoch-reuse-one-exit-named-standby-and-the-health-rule: a restart whose own shard-record read inside host::recover fails ends Rerun::Records and serves warm at its next incarnation, and a witness's expiry is judged when the host loop takes it from the standby's inbox. fleet-declared-holds-leave-the-self-suspicion-count-and-brake-nominations-at-three: after the stall heals the three held processes rerun in the same rounds, so the three declarations end together and no detector nominates after the heal. fleet-alarm-sets-match-on-root-1-of-every-scenario: the owner isolation fires producer-missing beside self-suspect-host and the zone loss fires the loss rows alone. fleet-world-restarts-every-owner-warm-and-judges-six-fleet-checks: an incarnation whose role read names another owner waits and acquires no tenure.

property_action.reason: Its invariant states the new contract of the takeover path: the standby's view period judges its witness at the time it takes the witness from its inbox, on its own host's clock, and its first device call follows its own acknowledged takeover write. Before this change the fleet judged a witness at the agent's turn and the assertion passed on the stored record alone, which a committed write with an unknown reply also leaves. The record's controls name a_witness_consumed_after_it_lapsed_starts_no_takeover_and_a_send_time_clock_fails_by_name and a_device_call_after_a_committed_but_unknown_takeover_write_fails_the_cas_before_device_check with their rule texts. The other seven invariants state what the same runs produce once two loads of one host run in the same rounds, or name a control this change adds, and each record lists the tests that assert it.
